intro.title: Silver Yantras
intro.descriptionHtml: Wide range of Yantras embossed on pure Silver sheets. These Yantras can be framed and kept at home or office or can be carried in purse/wallet. Silver Yantras help bring good fortune, good health and the favorable energies of the particular Deity or Mantra. Silver Yantras are effective and popular and help attract positivity and auspiciousness.
